1.name: Foundation
1.description: Basic conceptual understanding; needs guidance for practical tasks.

2.name: Working
2.description: Can perform common tasks with some guidance.

3.name: Proficient
3.description: Can independently perform expected role tasks.

4.name: Advanced
4.description: Can handle complex tasks, optimize solutions, and guide others.

roles.description: Develops, tests, maintains, and improves software applications.

competencies.name: Programming
competencies.description: Ability to write, understand, debug, and maintain software code.

sub_competencies.name: Programming Fundamentals
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding variables, data types, operators, control flow, functions, and program structure.

sub_competencies.name: Object-Oriented Programming
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to use classes, objects, abstraction, encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism appropriately.

sub_competencies.name: Debugging
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to identify, diagnose, reproduce, and fix software defects systematically.

competencies.name: Software Testing
competencies.description: Ability to verify software correctness and reliability with suitable tests.

sub_competencies.name: Unit Testing
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to test individual functions or components in isolation using clear assertions and test cases.

sub_competencies.name: Integration Testing
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to verify that multiple components or services interact correctly across boundaries.

roles.description: Builds usable, accessible, and maintainable client-side web interfaces.

competencies.name: Web Interface Development
competencies.description: Ability to build browser-based interfaces with modern web standards.

sub_competencies.name: Semantic HTML
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to structure web content using meaningful semantic HTML elements.

sub_competencies.name: Responsive CSS
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to create layouts that adapt correctly across screen sizes and devices.

sub_competencies.name: Client-Side JavaScript
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to implement browser-side logic, events, state, and asynchronous interactions.

competencies.name: Frontend Quality
competencies.description: Ability to produce accessible, performant, and usable interfaces.

sub_competencies.name: Accessibility
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to build interfaces that can be used by people with different accessibility needs and assistive technologies.

sub_competencies.name: Frontend Performance
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to identify and reduce browser loading, rendering, and runtime performance problems.

roles.description: Develops server-side applications, APIs, databases, and backend services.

competencies.name: Database Management
competencies.description: Ability to design, query, maintain, and optimize application databases.

sub_competencies.name: SQL
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to write and reason about SQL queries for reliable data retrieval and modification.

sub_competencies.name: Database Design
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to design schemas, relationships, keys, constraints, and normalized data structures.

sub_competencies.name: Indexing
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to select and use database indexes to improve retrieval performance while understanding storage and write trade-offs.

sub_competencies.name: Query Optimization
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to identify inefficient queries and improve execution using plans, indexes, and query restructuring.

competencies.name: API Development
competencies.description: Ability to design, implement, validate, secure, and test service APIs.

sub_competencies.name: REST API Design
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to design resource-oriented APIs with appropriate HTTP methods, status codes, and contracts.

sub_competencies.name: Authentication and Authorization
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to verify identity and enforce access control correctly in backend services.

sub_competencies.name: Input Validation
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to validate untrusted input and reject malformed or unsafe requests before processing.

roles.description: Prepares, analyses, visualizes, and interprets data to support decisions.

competencies.name: Data Preparation
competencies.description: Ability to make raw data reliable and analysis-ready.

sub_competencies.name: Data Cleaning
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to detect and address missing, duplicate, inconsistent, and invalid data.

sub_competencies.name: Data Transformation
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to reshape, encode, aggregate, and transform data for analysis.

competencies.name: Statistical Analysis
competencies.description: Ability to summarize and interpret data using suitable statistical methods.

sub_competencies.name: Descriptive Statistics
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to summarize distributions using measures of center, spread, and frequency.

sub_competencies.name: Statistical Inference
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to draw appropriately qualified conclusions about populations using sample evidence.

roles.description: Automates software delivery, infrastructure operation, deployment, and monitoring.

competencies.name: CI/CD
competencies.description: Ability to automate reliable build, test, and deployment workflows.

sub_competencies.name: Continuous Integration
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to automate source integration, build, and test execution for frequent code changes.

sub_competencies.name: Continuous Delivery
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to automate repeatable release and deployment workflows with appropriate controls.

competencies.name: Monitoring and Reliability
competencies.description: Ability to observe systems and respond to operational problems.

sub_competencies.name: Logging and Metrics
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to collect and interpret logs and metrics that describe application and infrastructure health.

sub_competencies.name: Incident Response
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to detect, triage, mitigate, communicate, and learn from operational incidents.

roles.description: Designs, configures, secures, and troubleshoots computer networks.

competencies.name: Networking Fundamentals
competencies.description: Ability to reason about addressing, routing, switching, and network protocols.

sub_competencies.name: IP Addressing and Subnetting
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to assign, interpret, and subnet IPv4/IPv6 address spaces correctly.

sub_competencies.name: Routing
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to understand and configure how packets are forwarded between networks.

competencies.name: Network Security
competencies.description: Ability to apply controls that protect network traffic and infrastructure.

sub_competencies.name: Firewall Policy
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to design and maintain firewall rules that permit required traffic while reducing unnecessary exposure.

sub_competencies.name: Network Troubleshooting
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to systematically isolate connectivity, routing, DNS, latency, and packet-loss problems.

roles.description: Monitors security events, investigates threats, and supports incident response.

competencies.name: Security Analysis
competencies.description: Ability to identify and interpret evidence of suspicious or malicious activity.

sub_competencies.name: Security Log Analysis
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to inspect logs and correlate events to identify suspicious behavior.

sub_competencies.name: Threat Detection
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to recognize indicators, attack patterns, and anomalous behavior that may indicate compromise.

competencies.name: Security Incident Response
competencies.description: Ability to investigate and contain cybersecurity incidents using structured procedures.

sub_competencies.name: Incident Triage
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to validate an alert, assess impact and severity, and prioritize response actions.

sub_competencies.name: Containment
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to limit the spread and impact of a confirmed incident while preserving necessary evidence.

roles.description: Designs, evaluates, maintains, and troubleshoots computer hardware systems and components.

competencies.name: Computer Architecture
competencies.description: Understanding of processor, memory, storage, buses, and I/O interaction.

sub_competencies.name: CPU Architecture
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding of instruction execution, registers, arithmetic units, control units, and processor organization.

sub_competencies.name: Memory Hierarchy
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding of registers, cache, RAM, storage, locality, and trade-offs across the memory hierarchy.

competencies.name: Hardware Troubleshooting
competencies.description: Ability to isolate and resolve failures in computer hardware systems.

sub_competencies.name: Fault Diagnosis
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to use symptoms, measurements, and controlled tests to isolate the likely failing component.

sub_competencies.name: Component Testing
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to safely test and validate hardware components using appropriate diagnostic methods and tools.

roles.description: Operates servers, operating systems, identities, backups, and core organizational IT services.

competencies.name: Systems Administration
competencies.description: Ability to configure, operate, and troubleshoot server operating systems and services.

sub_competencies.name: Linux Administration
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to manage users, permissions, processes, services, packages, and configuration on Linux systems.

sub_competencies.name: Identity and Access Administration
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to manage accounts, roles, permissions, and access lifecycle according to organizational policy.

competencies.name: Backup and Recovery
competencies.description: Ability to protect and restore systems and data after failures.

sub_competencies.name: Backup Management
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to configure, schedule, monitor, test, and retain backups appropriate to recovery needs.

sub_competencies.name: Disaster Recovery
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to restore critical services using documented recovery priorities, dependencies, and procedures.
